Nugget - Video editing software designed for motion effects and versatility.

summary.one_liner: CartCut (repo name nugget-app) is a layer-based video editor for motion effects, with an AI auto-caption feature, desktop builds, and an MCP bridge for Claude Code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a video editor built around layers rather than traditional tracks, so multiple effects can be applied to individual assets. Listed features include cut editing, keyframed re-position, scale, opacity and rotation animation, text, audio mixing, chromakey, blur (WebGL), drawn shapes, effects and transitions, and screen and audio recording. Rendering uses FFmpeg, and it supports common formats such as mp4, mov, mp3 and wav, plus 4k and 8k resolutions. AI auto captions are provided via whisper. An MCP integration lets Claude Code or other MCP clients edit the live timeline, with edits going into the app's undo history. Projects can be saved and loaded as files.
use_cases: Creating motion graphics and kinetic typography
Editing video with layers and keyframed animation
Mixing audio tracks for a video project
Letting an AI agent make edits to a timeline
how_to_run: Download ffmpeg and ffprobe into ./bin/<platform> (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, or win32-x64)
notable: Layer-based editing instead of track-based editing
MCP bridge lets Claude Code edit the live timeline with undo support
Builds for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows
Releases are mirrored to Cloudflare R2 by a GitHub workflow
caveats: Requires manually downloading native FFmpeg binaries into ./bin; macOS builds must be native to avoid large slowdowns under Rosetta
Needs Node.js and npm setup; chmod step is required
A limited demo is available on the website rather than the full app
